exact_statement: Version6 retains v5 at its original scope and adds the following theorem. For every Boolean controller a on an independent uniform physical control cube and arbitrary shared Boolean data sources G,H, define c=(1-a)/2, p=Pr(a=-1), V=4p(1-p), gamma=Pr(G!=H), J=JS_p(P_G,P_H), q_t=(1-p)Ghat(t)^2+pHhat(t)^2, and L=sum_t q_t h2(V(Ghat(t)-Hhat(t))^2/(4q_t))+V gamma H(P_a conditioned nonempty), with zero-row and V=0 conventions. Then H((1-c)G+cH)=(1-p)H(G)+pH(H)+J+L. At every data query, the signed entropy debit after subtracting both original source decrements and the signed L difference equals J-parent minus averaged J-children. At every control query this J difference is nonnegative. For EVERY finite adaptive mixed physical stopping tree, sum_DATA reach*debit+sum_CONTROL reach*Jrelease+E_terminal J=J_root, hence signed DATA payment never exceeds the SAME original J_root<=h2(p)<=1. Conditional on A028 v5 tensorized-JS price, J_root<=2log2(e)gamma I(a). No terminal KL reset payment or universal FEI admission is asserted.

exact_statement: For every finite number r of Boolean sources g_j on one shared uniform data cube X and every label map L from an independent uniform control cube Y, set F(y,x)=g_L(y)(x), pi_j=Pr(L=j), P_j(t)=ghat_j(t)^2, q=sum pi_j P_j, T=sum pi_j H(g_j), J=H(q)-T, and Lstr=H(S_Y|S_X) under the actual squared Fourier law. Then H(F)=T+J+Lstr and 0<=J<=min(H(pi),(2/ln(2))*I_controls(F)). At each DATA query the signed entropy residual after both original source decrements and signed structural variation equals Delta J; at each CONTROL query Delta J>=0. For every finite adaptive mixed physical stopping tree, sum_DATA reach*Delta J+sum_CONTROL reach*Delta J+E_leaf J=J_root. Both full terminal entropies T+J+Lstr are retained. If a SAME original supplied earmark U has an old debit b and U>=b+J_root, its unused value after those transactions is U-b-J_root+E_frontier J; after reserving complete frontier J only U-b-J_root can fund another reference conversion. A four-bit actual Boolean common-character point-defect fixture has J_root=0, first DATA debit -1, subsequent weighted DATA debit +1 and positive-part total 1, refuting clipping. Dummy-control extensions of a fixed positive-J three-label fixture show a renewed bank grows by depth while actual reserve stays J_root. No universal structural/source/reference payment or FEI conclusion is asserted.
